# Latona Township, Walsh County, North Dakota

Here is what I can tell you about Latona Township based on my knowledge:

## Basic Geographic Information

- Latona Township is one of the civil townships located in **Walsh County**, North Dakota
- Walsh County is situated in the **northeastern part of North Dakota**, bordering Minnesota to the east
- The county seat of Walsh County is **Grafton, North Dakota**

## General Characteristics

- Like most townships in this part of North Dakota, Latona Township is primarily an **agricultural area**, with the economy historically centered on grain farming (wheat, barley, sunflowers, etc.) and livestock
- The region was largely settled in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, during the great homesteading era on the northern Great Plains
- The area has a **continental climate** with cold winters and warm summers, typical of northeastern North Dakota
